u0: No key is currently in hand. This is the initial and returning success state: either the door is shut and locked while you wait for a key to land, or a previous key has just been used and the door is temporarily open before it relocks. Do not try to open the door without a key. Position yourself so you can respond quickly; when a key lands, follow the key-holding objective. If the door is currently open, wait through that period because no new key can arrive until it shuts.

Opening consumes the key and returns to u0; if you are already adjacent and facing the door, toggle now, otherwise move and turn into position.
